business_problem: The City of Helsinki needed to improve citizen service speed and flexibility, reduce pressure on overworked customer-service teams, and connect siloed service organizations without compromising privacy for sensitive public data.
solution_summary: The City of Helsinki worked with IBM Consulting to build a network of virtual assistants on IBM watsonx Assistant so citizens could reach city services faster and employees could absorb inquiry volumes. IBM Consulting and the city co-designed chatbot scope, tone, and user experience, then used IBM Garage workshops to build intent models from customer-service expertise when chat logs were unavailable. As the program expanded, assistants were connected to internal departments, other Finnish municipalities, and outside vendors, while IBM Watson Discovery was added to the internal IT assistant so unanswered questions could search a large instruction library. A multi-chatbot serving healthcare and social services also uses IBM Watson Language Translator to deliver Finnish, Swedish, and English experiences. The architecture lets Helsinki reuse training data, run sensitive workloads from a Finland data center when needed, and add new assistants without rebuilding from scratch.

solution_components.name: IBM Consulting
solution_components.role: Co-designed the virtual-assistant program, user experience, and implementation approach with city teams.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Assistant
solution_components.role: Runs the city's citizen-facing and employee-facing virtual assistants across multiple service domains.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosted the initial virtual-assistant deployment for the city.

solution_components.name: IBM Garage
solution_components.role: Provided the workshop methodology used to co-create chatbot training and implementation patterns.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Discovery
solution_components.role: Searches a large instruction library when the internal IT assistant cannot answer directly.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Language Translator
solution_components.role: Translates skills training services for the multi-chatbot into Swedish and English.

data_flow: Citizen or employee questions enter watsonx Assistant over web chat, APIs connect the assistant to city departments and outside systems, Watson Discovery searches instruction content when needed, and Language Translator expands multi-chatbot responses across Finnish, Swedish, and English experiences.
business_outcome: Helsinki created a scalable digital-assistant foundation that handles significant daily citizen demand, shortens queues, supports employees, and makes it easier to add new multilingual service assistants over time.
metrics: up to 300 customer contacts per day
6 healthcare and social services combined in the multi-chatbot
less than three months from start date to first launch
architecture_clues: The city wanted the solution to run from a local Finland data center when needed for sensitive workloads.
Chatbot training data was released on Helsinki Region Infoshare so other cities could reuse it.
The team continues to meet weekly with a local IBM team to plan new assistants and capabilities.
